data.raw_text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY
Projects commissioning in the FCT
Day 8- Monday 23rd June, 2025

Commissioning of the newly constructed road from A2 Junction (Abuja- Lokoja Road) to Pai Town please refers.

Accordingly, all sundry nuisances like trading and parking along the road corridor from the Giri interchange, Wazobia U-turn, and Pai Junction must be cleared before the deployment of law enforcement personnel.

Giri- Gwagwalada- Kwali (Pai Junction) will experience a surge in traffic as dignitaries will be routing to the venue about 13km away from the junction.

Your usual cooperation is highly solicited.

- Head Traffic, DRTS
